description: This C# source file defines the AttachedMediaFieldFileService class, which manages file operations related to attached media fields in OrchardCore CMS, including handling file uploads, deletions, and directory management.

classes.name: AttachedMediaFieldFileService
classes.description: Service class for managing media files attached to content items, including uploading, moving, and deleting files and directories.

methods.name: DeleteContentItemFolderAsync
methods.description: Deletes the directory associated with a specific content item.

methods.name: HandleFilesOnFieldUpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles moving uploaded files to the content item directory and cleaning up temporary files during media field updates.

methods.name: GetMediaFieldsTempSubFolder
methods.description: Returns the temporary upload directory path for the current user.

methods.name: EnsureGlobalDirectoriesAsync
methods.description: Ensures that the main media fields directory and temp directory exist.

methods.name: RemoveTemporaryAsync
methods.description: Removes temporary uploaded files that are marked as removed and are new.

methods.name: MoveNewFilesToContentItemDirAndUpdatePathsAsync
methods.description: Moves new uploaded files to the content item directory, updates their paths, and deletes empty directories.

methods.name: GetContentItemFolder
methods.description: Constructs the directory path for a specific content item.

methods.name: GetFileHashAsync
methods.description: Calculates a hash of a file to generate a unique filename.

methods.name: GetFileExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a file path.

methods.name: DeleteDirIfEmptyAsync
methods.description: Deletes a directory if it is empty.
